title: Horned Lizard Aankhon Se Khoon Kyun Fekti Hai? 🦎 #shorts
idea: The mind-blowing defense mechanism of the horned lizard squirting blood directly from its eyes up to 5 feet.

lines.text: Kya aap jante hain ek aisi chhipkali jo apni aankhon se khoon fekthi hai?
Horned lizard khatra dekhte hi apni eyeball ke pas se khoon squirt karti hai!
Ye khoon poore 5 feet yaani 1.5 meter door tak nishana lagakar fekti hai.
Sir mein blood pressure badha kar aankhon ke paas ki nasein faad deti hai!
Iski 21 species mein se 8 species ke paas ye super power hai!
Kya aapne kabhi aisi scary lizard dekhi hai? Comment mein batao!

facts.claim: Horned lizards can squirt blood from eyes up to 5 feet (1.5 m).
Squirting blood happens by restricting blood flow and rupturing vessels.
There are 21 species of horned lizards.
